name: 远程心跳检测 (rPPG)
description: 从面部视频检测生理心跳信号以验证人类存在。
useCase: Verifying real human presence视频中的 through remote photoplethysmography 分析
mechanism: 提取 subtle color changes in facial skin caused by blood circulation (rPPG signal) and 分析 its temporal characteristics. Real faces exhibit periodic color fluctuations corresponding to heartbeat. AI生成的 faces lack these physiological signals or produce incoherent 模式.
source: Ciftci, U. et al. (2020) - FakeCatcher: Detection of Synthetic Portrait Videos using Biological Signals, IEEE TPAMI
algorithm: rPPG Signal Extraction (CHROM/POS) + Power Spectrum Analysis + Physiological Plausibility Check
parameters: ROI: forehead + cheeks, Sampling: 30fps minimum, Window: 10 seconds, Frequency range: 0.7-4.0 Hz
